aluminium.name: Aluminium
aluminium.basis: Aluminum (LME) London Metal Exchange, unalloyed primary ingots, high grade, minimum 99.7% purity, settlement price.

bauxite.name: Bauxite, US import unit value, annual average
bauxite.basis: Price, average unit value of imports, free alongside ship (f.a.s.), dollars per metric ton.

cobalt.name: Cobalt cathode, US spot, annual average
cobalt.basis: Price, average, dollars per pound: U.S. spot, cathode. Source: S&P Global Platts Metals Week. Cobalt cathode is refined cobalt metal produced by an electrolytic process.

cocoa.name: Cocoa
cocoa.basis: Cocoa (ICCO), International Cocoa Organization daily price, average of the first three positions on the terminal markets of New York and London, nearest three future trading months.

coffee.name: Coffee, Arabica
coffee.basis: Coffee, Arabica (ICO), International Coffee Organization indicator price, other mild Arabicas, average New York and Bremen/Hamburg markets, ex-dock.

copper.name: Copper
copper.basis: Copper (LME), grade A, minimum 99.9935% purity, cathodes and wire bar shapes, settlement price.

corn.name: Maize (US Gulf)
corn.basis: Maize (U.S.), no. 2, yellow, f.o.b. US Gulf ports.

cotton.name: Cotton, A Index
cotton.basis: Cotton (Cotton Outlook "CotlookA index"), middling 1-3/32 inch, traded in Far East, C/F.

crude-oil.name: Brent crude, daily spot (FOB)
crude-oil.basis: EIA series RBRTE: Europe Brent Spot Price FOB (Dollars per Barrel)

gold.name: Gold
gold.basis: Gold, spot average of daily rates.

iron-ore.name: Iron ore, CFR China spot
iron-ore.basis: Iron ore (any origin) fines, spot price, c.f.r. China, 62% Fe.

lithium.name: Lithium carbonate, battery grade, annual average
lithium.basis: Price, annual average-real, battery-grade lithium carbonate, dollars per metric ton. Lithium carbonate price assessments for spot and long-term contracts. Source: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence Ltd.

lng.name: LNG, Japan import price
lng.basis: Liquefied natural gas (Japan), LNG, import price, cif.

lpg.name: Propane, Mont Belvieu, daily spot
lpg.basis: EIA series EER_EPLLPA_PF4_Y44MB_DPG: Mont Belvieu, TX Propane Spot Price FOB (Dollars per Gallon)

manganese.name: Manganese ore, CIF China, annual average
manganese.basis: Price, average, manganese content, cost, insurance, and freight, China, dollars per metric ton unit. Manganese content typically ranges from 35% to 54% for manganese ore and from 74% to 95% for ferromanganese. For average metallurgical-grade ore containing 44% manganese. Source: CRU Group.

natural-gas.name: Henry Hub natural gas, daily spot
natural-gas.basis: EIA series RNGWHHD: Henry Hub Natural Gas Spot Price (Dollars per Million Btu)

nickel.name: Nickel
nickel.basis: Nickel (LME), cathodes, minimum 99.8% purity, settlement price.

palm-oil.name: Palm oil
palm-oil.basis: Palm oil (Malaysia), RBD, average export price FOB.

pgm.name: Platinum
pgm.basis: Platinum, 99.95% minimum purity, plate or ingot form, spot average of daily rates.

phosphate.name: DAP
phosphate.basis: DAP (diammonium phosphate), spot, f.o.b. US Gulf.

potash.name: Potassium chloride (potash)
potash.basis: Potassium chloride (muriate of potash), Brazil CFR granular spot price.

rapeseed.name: Rapeseed oil
rapeseed.basis: Rapeseed Oil, Dutch rapeseed oil, FOB Rotterdam.

rare-earths.name: NdPr oxide, annual average
rare-earths.basis: Price, average, dollars per kilogram: Neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) oxide, 99% minimum. Free on board. Source: Argus Media group, Argus Non-Ferrous Markets.

refined-products.name: Gasoline, New York Harbor, daily spot
refined-products.basis: EIA series EER_EPMRU_PF4_Y35NY_DPG: New York Harbor Conventional Gasoline Regular Spot Price FOB (Dollars per Gallon)

rice.name: Rice, Thai 5%
rice.basis: Rice (Thailand), 5% broken, white rice (WR), milled, indicative price based on weekly surveys of export transactions, government standard, f.o.b. Bangkok.

soybeans.name: Soybeans
soybeans.basis: Soybeans, U.S. Soybeans, FOB U.S. Gulf.

soymeal.name: Soybean meal
soymeal.basis: Soybean meal, U.S. Soymeal, 48% protein, average weekly price, FOB Rotterdam.

soyoil.name: Soybean oil
soyoil.basis: Soybean oil, U.S. Soybean Oil, Crude Degummed, FOB U.S. Gulf.

sugar.name: Sugar, world
sugar.basis: Sugar (World), International Sugar Agreement (ISA) daily price, raw, f.o.b. and stowed at greater Caribbean ports.

thermal-coal.name: Thermal coal, Australia (Newcastle)
thermal-coal.basis: Coal (Australia), port thermal, f.o.b. Newcastle, 6000 kcal/kg futures price.

urea.name: Urea
urea.basis: Urea, (Ukraine), prill spot f.o.b. Middle East.

wheat.name: Wheat, US HRW
wheat.basis: Wheat (U.S.), no. 2 hard red winter Gulf export price.

zinc.name: Zinc
zinc.basis: Zinc (LME), high grade, minimum 99.95% purity, settlement price.
